item.title: Merge, Medical Murray Form Partnership to Support Early Medical Device Innovation
item.description: NORTH BARRINGTON, Ill.—Medical Murray and Merge have announced a strategic partnership aimed at improving how early medical device concepts move toward manufacturing, with a focus on bridging exploratory research and development and future regulated development.

item.title: Kimball Electronics to Open New Medical Manufacturing Facility in Indianapolis
item.description: JASPER, Ind. — Kimball Electronics plans to open a new medical manufacturing facility in Indianapolis. The official ribbon-cutting ceremony will take place Friday, Feb. 6.

item.title: Fuel Cell Manufacturing Joint Venture to End as Honda, GM Shift Strategy
item.description: TOKYO— Honda Motor Co. said it will discontinue production of its current fuel cell system before the end of 2026, ending output from its joint venture with General Motors as Honda shifts to fuel cell technologies developed independently in-house.

item.title: New Automation Products Emphasize Compact, High-Load Performance
item.description: Several new products highlight recent innovations across industrial automation, focusing on compact design and higher load capacity.

item.title: Deere to Build New Factory in North Carolina
item.description: MOLINE, IL—Deere & Co. plans to build a new assembly plant in Kernersville, NC, to produce next-generation excavators.

item.title: GE Appliances Opens In-House Water Filter Operation in Louisville
item.description: LOUISVILLE, Ky. –GE Appliances is launching its first-ever in-house water filter manufacturing operation at Appliance Park.

item.title: Tesla to Shift EV Production at California Plant
item.description: FREMONT, CA—Tesla Inc. plans to stop making electric vehicles at its flagship factory here and scale up production of humanoid robots instead.

item.title: Micro-Scale Leak Testing of Medical Devices
item.description: Given the highly infectious nature of the COVID pathogen, tests for the virus had to be quick, reliable and safe. The test components and transfer devices had to be leak-proof—both to give accurate test results and to prevent infection of the clinicians performing the tests.

item.title: Servo Presses Play Key Role in Assembling Hydraulic Suspension Components
item.description: They offer micron-level press-fitting accuracy, enabling stringent control over the motion and force applied to seals.

item.title: EOS Expands Metal Additive Manufacturing Assembly in Texas
item.description: PFLUGERVILLE, Texas—EOS is expanding metal additive manufacturing assembly and logistics operations in Texas as part of a $3 million investment aimed at increasing U.S.-based production capacity and shortening delivery times for North American customers.
